subject: Business Studies
central_question: How do external forces shape business decisions, and how should enterprises respond to environmental change and economic policy reforms?
in_scope_units: Economic, social, technological, political and legal dimensions

known_pitfalls.claim: Business environment means only economic conditions.
known_pitfalls.correction: It includes economic, social, technological, political, legal and other external forces.

known_pitfalls.claim: A firm can control its environment.
known_pitfalls.correction: A firm usually cannot control external forces and must monitor and adapt.

known_pitfalls.claim: Liberalisation, privatisation and globalisation are identical.
known_pitfalls.correction: They concern different changes in controls, ownership and international integration.

ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: Exercises contain Very Short Answer questions 1-5, Short Answer questions 1-4 and Long Answer questions 1-5.
